parameters.query: SELECT p.slug, p.display_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM captures c WHERE c.project_id=p.id AND c.captured_at > NOW()-INTERVAL '7 days') as captures_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entities e WHERE e.project_id=p.id AND e.first_seen_at > NOW()-INTERVAL '7 days') as entities_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alerts a WHERE a.project_id=p.id AND a.created_at > NOW()-INTERVAL '7 days') as alerts_count FROM projects p ORDER BY p.priority, p.slug
